faq.a1: A'a. DeHub a dehub.io ne mai zaman kansa bude tushen kafofin watsa labarun dandamali. DePaul University ta DeHUB dalibi portal, Rowan ta DEHub da kuma deHUB Access kofa shiga app ne maras alaka kayayyakin da suka faru don raba sunan.
faq.a2: Ee. DeHub kyauta ne don saukewa daga Google Play da App Store, kuma kyauta don amfani a cikin mai bincike a dehub.io.
faq.a3: Wayoyin Android ta hanyar Google Play ko saukar da APK kai tsaye, iPhone ta hanyar App Store, da kowane tebur na zamani ko burauzar wayar hannu a dehub.io.
faq.a4: Ee. An buga sabon ginin Android ta DeHub azaman zazzage APK kai tsaye a dehub.io/apk, don Android 8 da sama.
faq.a5: Post zuwa wani lokaci ciyar, je live ko watch live kõguna, sako abokai tare da karshen-to-karshen boye-boye, shiga da kuma gudanar da al'ummomi, rike alamomi a cikin ginannen Multi-chain walat da kuma samun lada ga kallo.

dehubAppPage.intro1: DeHub cibiyar sadarwar zamantakewa ne mai tsaka-tsaki da aikace-aikacen wayar hannu, a ci gaba tun daga 2021, inda za a iya buga sakonnin a kan-chain kuma masu kirkiro suna kiyaye masu sauraron su, abubuwan da suke ciki da kudaden shiga.
dehubAppPage.intro2: Ya haɗu da ciyarwar lokaci, raye-raye mai rai, saƙon ɓoye na ƙarshe zuwa ƙarshe, al'ummomin masu amfani, walat mai yawa da lada da aka biya a cikin alamomi. Haka asusun aiki a kan Android, iPhone da kuma a kowane zamani browser.

faq.a1: Ee. DeHub kyauta ne don shiga kuma kyauta don aikawa, kuma minting rafi a kan-chain zaɓi ne. Ana biyan kuɗin shigo da tashar, kuma ana nuna farashinsa kafin ku biya.
faq.a2: A'a. Ci gaba da yawo inda masu sauraron ku suke a yau kuma ku gina DeHub tare da shi. Cross-post daga DeHub mawallafin don haka kowane dandamali da kuka riga kuka yi amfani da maki baya ga masu sauraro da kuka mallaka.
faq.a3: Ee. Pick OBS lokacin da kuka tafi rayuwa kuma DeHub yana ba ku maɓallin gudana na dindindin don OBS, Streamlabs ko kowane RTMP encoder. Hakanan zaka iya tafiya kai tsaye daga wayarka, mai bincikenka ko katin kamawa.
faq.a4: Masu kallo suna tip da aika kyauta a lokacin rafi, kuma waɗanda ke zaune a kan-chain a cikin alamun DeHub kai tsaye zuwa walat ɗin ku. Uploads kuma iya zama free, biya-per-view ko token-gated.
faq.a5: Bude shafin haɗin gwiwa don samun hanyar haɗin ku. Duk wanda ya shiga ta hanyar shi an danganta ku, kuma kuna samun 20% na ayyukansu tare da 5% maimaitawa daga mutanen da suke gayyata, an biya su a cikin alamun DeHub.

streamPage.heading: Rafi a kan DeHub
streamPage.howToStart: Yi rijista, buɗe mawaƙa na post kuma buga Go kai tsaye — daga kyamararka, OBS ko katin kamawa.
streamPage.intro: Kawo masu kallonka na kai tsaye zuwa dandamalin da kake da ikon mallaka. Yi watsa shirye-shirye kai tsaye daga wayarka, burauzarka ko OBS, karɓi kyaututtuka kai tsaye yayin da kake watsa shirye-shiryen, kuma ka riƙe masu kallon da ka gina. Ƙungiyar da ke bayan First Class Agency ce ta gina DeHub, wadda ita ce hukumar haɗin gwiwa ta TikTok LIVE ta farko a Burtaniya, mai fiye da masu watsa shirye-shirye 1,000.

reasons.body1: Masu kallo tip da aika kyaututtuka yayin da kake rayuwa, tare da tayered kyauta animations da tip saƙonni karanta sauti a kan rafi. Tips zauna a kan-chain a DeHub alamomi da kuma sauka kai tsaye a cikin walat maimakon a clipped a kan hanya ta hanyar.
reasons.body2: Mabiyanku ba jere ba ne a cikin bayanan wani. Streams da uploads za a iya minted a kan-chain to your walat, da ciyar ne chronological, da kuma code ne bude tushen, don haka babu wanda a hankali rewrites dokoki.
reasons.body3: Haɗin gayyatarku yana biyan ku 20% na aikin duk wanda ya shiga ta hanyarsa, ƙari 5% yana maimaitawa daga mutanen da suke ci gaba da gayyata, an biya su a cikin alamun DeHub.
reasons.body4: Mai watsa shiri live audio Stages for tambayoyi, nakasa da kuma watch jam'iyyun. Sanar da ɗaya a gaba tare da katin da masu sauraron ku zasu iya rabawa, kuma ku saurari waɗanda aka rubuta.
reasons.body5: Haɗa sauran asusunku sau ɗaya kuma buga zuwa X, Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, Farcaster da ƙarin dandamali takwas daga mawallafin DeHub. Ci gaba da TikTok a matsayin injin bincikenku yayin da kuke gina masu sauraro da kuka mallaka.
reasons.body6: Shigo da tashar YouTube gaba ɗaya, ko bayanin martaba na TikTok, Vimeo ko SoundCloud, a cikin rukuni ɗaya. Ana nuna ainihin farashi a cikin alamun DeHub kafin ku biya.

dao.subtitle: Wata walat, wadda al'umma ke ba da kuɗi, ana kashewa ta hanyar zaɓensu
dao.contributeIntro: Aiko da token na DeHub daga walat ɗinka zuwa baitulmali. Duk token da ka ƙara yana ƙara rabonka a cikin rukunin, kuma rabonka shine nauyin da ƙuri'arka ke da shi lokacin da DAO ta yanke shawarar yadda za a kashe shi.

dao.howItWorksBody: Ikonka shine gudummawarka da aka raba da duk abin da aka taɓa aika wa gidan kuɗi. Ana karanta shi kai tsaye daga sarkar, ba ya ƙarewa, kuma yana yanke shawara kan yawan nauyin da muryarka ke ɗauka lokacin da DAO ke zaɓe kan kashe kuɗi.

proof.title: Daga ina waɗannan lambobin suka fito
proof.subtitle: Cloudflare ne ya auna, ba wannan shafin ba
proof.query: Ainihin tambayar da ke bayan jadawalin
proof.edge: Kowace buƙata zuwa dehub.io tana wucewa ta Cloudflare kafin ta isa sabobinmu. Waɗannan ƙididdiga tarin Cloudflare ne na wannan zirga-zirgar — lambobi ɗaya da dashboard ɗinmu ke nunawa. Ba rubutun shiri a burauzarka ne ke tara su ba, don haka babu abin da ke wannan shafin da zai iya kumbura su, kuma toshe masu bin sawu ba ya canza su.
proof.live: Shafin yana karanta su kai tsaye. Loda /stats yana kiran ƙarshen mu, wanda a lokacin yake tambayar Analytics API na Cloudflare kuma yana ajiye amsar na daƙiƙa 60.
proof.limits: Abin da wannan ke nunawa da wanda ba ya nunawa: za ka ga cewa lambobin sun fito daga tarin Cloudflare ba daga lambar manhajarmu ba, kuma tambayar da aka buga nan ita ce wadda ke gudana. Ba ba tare da amana ba ce — mu ne muke da alamar API, kuma Cloudflare ba ya bayar da karatun jama'a na binciken yanki. Duk wanda ke da yankin Cloudflare nasa zai iya gudanar da tambaya ɗaya kuma ya tabbatar da tsarinta.

definitions.title: Ma'anar waɗannan lambobin
definitions.visitors: — adireshin IP na musamman da Cloudflare ya gani a wannan ranar. Kusa da adadin mutane, amma ba ɗaya ba: ofis a kan haɗi ɗaya ana ƙidaya shi sau ɗaya, kuma waya da ke sauyawa tsakanin wifi da bayanan salula ana ƙidaya ta sau biyu.
definitions.pageViews: — buƙatun da Cloudflare ke rarrabawa a matsayin lodin shafuka, ba hotuna, rubutun shirye-shirye ko kiran API ba.
definitions.bots: — waɗannan ƙididdiga ne na ɗanye a gefen hanyar sadarwa, don haka masu rarrafe, masu sa ido kan aiki da abokan ciniki na rubutu suna cikinsu. Za ka gan su da kanka a rarrabuwar burauza da ke sama, inda shigarwa kamar "Curl" da "Ba a sani ba" zirga-zirga ce ta atomatik ba mutane ba. Tace bots yana buƙatar tsarin Cloudflare mai biya wanda ba mu da shi, kuma cire ƙiyasi a shiru zai sa lambobin su zama masu wuyar tabbatarwa, ba masu sauƙi ba.
definitions.total: — kallon shafuka da buƙatu suna taruwa a duk kewayon. Ba a tara adadin baƙi da gangan zuwa "jimillar baƙi" ba, domin wanda ya zo Litinin da Talata za a ƙidaya shi sau biyu.
definitions.peak: — mafi girman ƙidaya na musamman a kowane tazara ɗaya na kewayon, saboda dalili ɗaya: lamba ce da Cloudflare ke aunawa da gaske, ba wadda aka gina ta hanyar tara ƙididdiga masu haɗuwa ba.
definitions.resolutionTerm: Bayanan awa suna tsayawa a kwanaki 3
definitions.resolution: — wannan iyakar Cloudflare ce a wannan tsarin, ba zaɓinmu ba: yana ƙin duk tambayar awa da ta wuce kwanaki uku. Kallon awanni 24 da kwanaki 3 na awa ne; kwanaki 7 zuwa sama na yau da kullum ne, kuma babu yadda za a zana jadawalin awa na dukan lokacin.
definitions.breakdown: — suna bin kewayon da ka zaɓa, amma har kwanaki {{max}} baya kawai, domin haka ake ajiye rarrabuwar yau da kullum. A kewayo mafi tsayi, jadawalin yana rufe lokaci fiye da jerin ƙasashe.
definitions.start: — "dukan lokacin" na nufin kowace rana da Cloudflare ke ajiyewa har yanzu, yau kwanaki {{days}} tun {{date}}, ranar da dehub.io ya koma Cloudflare. Babu bayanan gefe na baya da za a nuna, kuma tsofaffin kwanaki suna faɗuwa yayin da Cloudflare ke ƙare musu lokaci.
definitions.estimated: — tun {{date}}, dehub.io an yi amfani da shi ta hanyar uwar garken sake dawowa don haka hanyoyin sadarwar da ba za su iya isa Cloudflare kai tsaye har yanzu suna ɗora shafin ba. Cloudflare to yana ganin yawancin baƙi a matsayin adireshin relay ɗaya, kuma ƙididdigarsa ta musamman ta rushe. Ga waɗancan kwanakin ginshiƙi yana nuna ra'ayoyin shafi da aka auna da aka ninka ta hanyar yawan baƙi-per-page-view rabo na {{days}} kwanaki kafin ({{ratio}}%). Ra'ayoyin shafi da buƙatun har yanzu ana auna su kai tsaye, kuma ƙididdigar Cloudflare wanda ba a taɓa ba yana cikin amsar da aka haɗa a sama.

taxSplit.footnote: Kudaden gudanarwa da aka ajiye ne kawai ake ƙidaya a matsayin kudaden shiga a sama. Sayen da aka mayar da su da ladan da aka raba ana rubuta su daban. Ana iya duba kowane adadi da kuɗin asali a cikin littafin.
taxSplit.grossFootnote: Jimlar kudaden shiga da ke sama ya haɗa da BNB da aka raba tare da masu riƙewa da masu stakers. An rarraba waɗannan biyan kuɗi, ba DeHub ya riƙe su ba. Buybacks ci gaba da rabuwa. kowane adadin da asali kudin za a iya duba a cikin ledger.

premium.diveAiBody: 500 Mataimakin saƙonni, 150 AI images, da kuma 20 seconds na generated video kowane wata. Isasshen ginawa, jirgi da post — ba mai shayi ba.
premium.faqWhatIsAnAdQ: Menene ya ƙidaya azaman talla akan DeHub?
premium.faqWhatIsAnAdA: An gabatar da sakonnin a cikin ciyarwarka, haɓaka banners, da sanya tallafi a Explore. Premium yana kawar da su duka.
premium.faqSwitchPlansQ: Zan iya sauyawa tsakanin Extra da Family?

premium.faqTopTierStakerQ: Ni ne mai tsattsauran ra'ayi na sama. Har yanzu ina biyan kuɗi?
premium.faqTopTierStakerA: A'a. Top 7 staking tiers samun DeHub Extra free. Top 4 tiers samun DeHub Family free. Unstake da perks lift — sakewa kuma sun dawo.
premium.faqPayInDhbQ: Zan iya biyan kuɗi da alamomin DeHub?
premium.faqPayInDhbA: Biyan kuɗi da katin lokacin da aka fara. Biyan kuɗi da alamomin DeHub yana zuwa nan da nan kuma za a haɗa da ragi.

jobs.seoTitle: Ayyuka a DeHub — Buɗe Ayyuka a Yanar Gizo3 Social Media
jobs.seoDescription: Shiga cikin ƙungiyar DeHub — bude matsayi a ci gaban kasuwanci, tallace-tallace da ƙari.
jobs.heading: Ayyuka a DeHub
jobs.subheading: Kasance tare da ƙungiyar da ke gina makomar kafofin watsa labarun da ba su da tsakiya
jobs.intro: Muna neman mutane masu sha'awar da suke so su shiga cikin raƙuman kafofin watsa labarun na gaba — wanda ke sanya masu kirkiro da al'ummomi na farko. Duk rawar suna cikakken nesa tare da awanni masu sassauci , yana ba ku 'yancin yin aiki daga ko'ina a duniya.
jobs.tagBdmPay: Albashi mai sassaucin ra'ayi + Hukumar OTE
jobs.bdmAbout: A matsayinka na ɗaya daga cikin Manajojin Ci gaban Kasuwanci a DeHub, za ka kasance wani ɓangare na ƙarfin tuƙi a bayan dabarun haɗin gwiwarmu. Manufarka ita ce ganowa, shiga, da rufe yarjejeniyoyi tare da kamfanoni a duk faɗin Web2 da Web3 — daga ɗakunan wasan kwaikwayo da dandamalin abun ciki zuwa ayyukan blockchain da yarjejeniyoyin DeFi. Wannan matsayi ne na hukumar OTE (Samun Kuɗi akan Manufa): gwargwadon yadda kake ƙoƙari, gwargwadon yadda kake samu. Matsayin yana da sauƙi, kawo kamfanoni, ayyuka, al'ummomi ko kowane babban asusun martaba zuwa DeHub, kuma a biya ka. Manufar ita ce, ƙarin wayar da kan jama'a yana haifar da ƙarin haɓaka ga tsarinmu, wanda ke biyan ku ƙarin kari don yaƙin neman zaɓe mai nasara. Wannan madauki ne na haɓaka mara iyaka tare da yuwuwar samun kuɗi mara iyaka. Kawo masu talla zuwa dandamali yana buɗe ƙarin kari da tsarin hukumar da ke jagorantar masana'antu — ƙimar da kuke kawowa, ƙarin abin da kuke samu. Ko da waɗanda ba su da gogewa ana gayyatar su don neman aiki, idan halin da ya dace don matsayin yana nan.
jobs.bdmResp1: Gano da amintaccen haɗin gwiwa na dabaru tare da kamfanonin Web2 da Web3 waɗanda suka dace da aikin DeHub
jobs.bdmResp2: Gina da sarrafa bututun abokan hulɗa masu yiwuwa, masu tallafawa, da damar haɗuwa
jobs.bdmResp3: Wakiltar DeHub a taron masana'antu, tarurruka, da taron kama-da-wane
jobs.bdmResp4: Sharuɗɗan haɗin gwiwa na tattaunawa, samfuran raba kudaden shiga, da yarjejeniyar haɗin gwiwa
jobs.bdmResp5: Haɗin gwiwa tare da samfuran da ƙungiyoyin tallace-tallace don haɓaka kamfen ɗin haɗin gwiwa da haɗakarwa
jobs.bdmWant1: Tabbatar da kwarewa a ci gaban kasuwanci, haɗin gwiwa, ko tallace-tallace a cikin fasaha, caca, ko Web3
jobs.bdmWant2: Strong data kasance cibiyar sadarwa a cikin crypto/Web3 ko mahalicci tattalin arziki sarari ne mai girma plus
jobs.bdmWant3: Kyakkyawan ƙwarewar sadarwa da tattaunawa — zaku iya rufe yarjejeniya da gina dangantaka mai ɗorewa
jobs.bdmWant4: Kai-motivated da kuma dadi aiki kai tsaye a cikin wani nesa-farko yanayi
jobs.bdmWant5: Gaskiya sha'awa a decentralised kafofin watsa labarun, NFTs, ko blockchain fasaha
jobs.bdmCompensation: Wannan matsayi yana ba da albashi na asali mai sassaucin ra'ayi tare da tsarin hukumar OTE mara iyaka wanda ke da alaƙa kai tsaye da haɗin gwiwar da kuke kawowa. Masu yin fice suna da yuwuwar samun kuɗi mara iyaka.

jobs.pastExperiencePlaceholder: Faɗa mana game da BD ɗin ku mai dacewa, haɗin gwiwa, ko ƙwarewar tallace-tallace. Haɗa kamfanoni, masana'antu, da kuma manyan yarjejeniyoyi idan ya dace...

jobs.ambassadorAbout: A matsayinka na Jakadan DeHub Brand kai ne fuska da muryar dandamali a cikin al'ummarku. Aikinku shine yada kalmar game da DeHub a fadin kowane tashar da kuka taɓa — kafofin watsa labarun, IRL tarups, abubuwan caca, sansanin jami'a, da kuma bayan. Wannan aikin albashi ne da aka biya kowane wata, ba bisa ga kwamiti ba; za ku sami daidaitattun kudaden shiga yayin girma tare da dandamali.
jobs.ambResp1: Irƙiri da raba ainihin abun ciki game da DeHub a duk tashoshin zamantakewar ku na sirri (X, TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, da dai sauransu)
jobs.ambResp2: Actively shiga tare da DeHub al'umma a kan app — post, sharhi, da kuma hulɗa da sauran masu amfani
jobs.ambResp3: Ku halarci kuma ku wakilci DeHub a abubuwan da suka faru na ainihi, tarurruka, da tarurruka a yankinku
jobs.ambResp4: Kawo sabbin masu amfani zuwa dandamali ta hanyar hanyar sadarwar ka
jobs.ambWant1: Kasancewar kafofin watsa labarun mai aiki tare da haɗin kai na gaskiya (ƙididdigar mabiya batutuwa ƙasa da gaskiya)
jobs.ambWant2: Jin daɗi don Web3, crypto, caca, ko al'adun mahalicci
jobs.ambWant3: Ƙwarewar sadarwa mai ƙarfi da ikon bayyana ra'ayoyi masu rikitarwa kawai
jobs.ambWant4: Mai gabatar da kai wanda zai iya tsarawa da aiwatar da kamfen da kansa
jobs.ambWant5: Jakadan da ya gabata, mai tasiri, ko ƙwarewar gudanar da al'umma shine kari
jobs.ambassadorCompensation: Jakadun Brand suna karɓar albashin wanda za'a iya yin shawarwari a kowane wata an biya shi akai-akai. Ƙarin kari za a iya bayar bisa ga kamfen yi, mai amfani sign-ups, da kuma al'umma girma milestones. Har ila yau, za ku karɓi kayan DeHub na musamman, damar fasalin farko, da kuma rarraba alamomi yayin da tsarin halittu ke girma.
jobs.noRoleFits: Ba ku ga rawar da ta dace ba? Isar da mu a kan <mail>dev@dehub.io</mail> — koyaushe muna neman ƙwararrun mutane.

depin.seoDescription: DeHub DePin yana ba mutane damar ba da gudummawa ga ajiya, bandwidth da compute don taimakawa mai watsa shiri, transcode da isar da kafofin watsa labarai ta hanyar cibiyar sadarwa mai juriya.
depin.heroTitle: Kayan aikin ku. cibiyar sadarwar kafofin watsa labarai na DeHub.
depin.heroBlurb: Bayar da ajiya na spare, bandwidth da compute don taimakawa mai watsa shiri, transcode da isar da abun ciki na DeHub.
depin.heroImageAlt: A compact gefen-compute node da alaka da gidaje da kuma mahalicci studios
depin.heroCaption: DeHub yana ci gaba da kwafin asali. Community nodes ƙara m replicas da kuma gida bayarwa iya aiki.
depin.earlyAccessBody: Node mai sauƙi, mai bincike yana rayuwa a ƙasa. A nauyi, ko da yaushe-on tebur node ne a bayyana nan gaba shugabanci, ba samuwa tukuna. Shiga bai taba bada tabbacin lada ba.
depin.runFromTabTitle: Gudu da node daga wannan shafin.
depin.runFromTabBody: Babu shigarwa, babu saukewa. Shiga, zaɓi, kuma shafin burauzarku na budewa ya fara riƙe kwafin na biyu na 'yan kafofin watsa labarai na DeHub.
depin.statNotTracked: Ba a bi shi ba tukuna.
depin.statUnavailable: Ba a samu ba a yanzu.
depin.signInBlurb: Shiga don juya wannan browser tab a cikin wani haske madadin node.
depin.optInBlurb: Wannan matakin yana gudana gaba ɗaya a cikin burauzar ku ta amfani da ajiya na gida (OPFS). Yana ba da gudummawa kawai yayin da wannan shafin ya kasance a buɗe — rufe shi ya dakatar da node ɗinku, kuma sake buɗewa ya fara sabon. Babu shigarwa kuma babu abin da ke gudana a baya.
depin.unsupportedTitle: Ba a tallafawa a cikin wannan burauzar ba
depin.unsupportedBlurb: Browser ajiya nodes bukatar Origin Private File System goyon baya, wanda wannan browser ba ya bayar (wannan shi ne na kowa a kan Safari). Gwada wani kwanan nan Chrome, Edge ko Firefox maimakon.
depin.rejectedBlurb: Cibiyar sadarwar ta ƙi wannan zaman node, wanda yawanci yana nufin ya ƙare yayin da shafin ya buɗe. Shiga kuma zaɓi — babu abin da ya ɓace.
depin.dhbEarnedThisPeriod: Alamomi da aka samu a wannan lokacin
depin.notTrackedYet: Ba a sa ido ba tukuna
depin.threeJobsTitle: Ɗaya daga cikin node, ayyuka uku masu amfani.
depin.threeJobsBody: Operators zabi su ajiya, bandwidth da kuma compute iyaka. DeHub jadawalin kawai aikin da injin su zai iya sarrafawa lafiya.
depin.transcodeImageAlt: A gida mahalicci workstation bada gudummawa spare GPU lissafi
depin.transcodeBody: Ya cancanta inji juya uploaded video cikin adaptive renditions. Kowane fitarwa ana duba shi kafin a iya bauta masa.
depin.hostBody: Nodes suna ci gaba da ɓoyayyen ɓangarori ko abubuwan da aka saka a cikin cache na gida. DeHub asalin ajiya ya kasance tushen gaskiya.
depin.deliverBody: Kusa da takwarorinsu raba video segments yayin da al'ada bayarwa hanya tsaya a shirye a matsayin atomatik fallback.
depin.nodesLeaveTitle: Cibiyar sadarwar da ke sa ran nodes su bar.
depin.nodesLeaveBody: Babu wani na'ura na al'umma da ke riƙe da kwafin kawai. Binciken kiwon lafiya, replicas da asalin fallback ci gaba da sake kunnawa samuwa.
depin.originBody: Kwafin tushe na dindindin da isar da fallback
depin.availableReplicasBody: Ku bauta wa sassan da aka tabbatar kusa da buƙata
depin.offlineNodeBody: An cire shi daga tafiya har sai ya sake haɗuwa
depin.viewerBody: Yi amfani da takwarorina idan akwai, asalin lokacin da ake buƙata
depin.privacyTitle: Hosts kantin sayar da guda, ba samun dama ba.
depin.privacyBody: Kafofin watsa labarai masu kariya suna ɓoyewa akan kayan aikin al'umma. Ana ba da maɓallan sake kunnawa daban ga masu kallo da aka ba da izini.
depin.protectedContentBody: Subscriber, masu zaman kansu da kuma biya-per-view segments za a iya adana a matsayin ciphertext. Masu aiki na Node ba sa karɓar maɓallan haƙƙin kawai saboda suna karɓar bayanai.
depin.publicContentBody: Encryption hana m dubawa na cached fayiloli, amma jama'a kafofin watsa labarai zauna watchable ta hanyar jama'a DeHub player. Ba za mu yi ikirarin in ba haka ba.
depin.operatorControlsBody: Operators zabi faifai iyaka, bandwidth iyaka, aiki hours da kuma cancanci jama'a abun ciki Categories. Cire sanarwa trigger cache purges.
depin.verifiedWorkTitle: An tabbatar da aiki mai amfani. Sakamakon lada ya kasance mai canzawa.
depin.verifiedWorkBody: Ana auna gudummawa ta hanyar rasit ɗin da aka sanya hannu, duba lafiyar lafiya da tabbatarwar fitarwa. Ajiye kawai ba ya haifar da lada.
depin.deliveryReceiptsBody: Tabbatar da bytes bauta wa real sake kunnawa zaman.
depin.availabilityBody: Binciken dawo da nasara da ingantaccen sabis lokacin da aka sanya shi.
depin.validOutputBody: Transcodes dole ne wuce fasaha da samfurin ingancin dubawa.
depin.revenuePool: Pool da aka samar da kuɗi
depin.revenuePoolBody: Idan an kunna, za a saita kasafin kuɗi na lada daga kudaden shiga na dandamali bayan an rufe lokacin.
depin.noFixedRate: Babu wani adadi na musamman, mafi ƙarancin dawowa, APY ko kimantawa ta gaba. Bayanan gudummawa sune shigarwar lissafi kawai, ba alkawarin biya ba. Duk wani sashe na gaba na token zai faru akan Base kuma ya kasance ƙarƙashin cancanta, ƙa'idodin cibiyar sadarwa da dokar da ta dace.
depin.runningCosts: Gudun node yana amfani da wutar lantarki, bayanan intanet da rayuwar kayan aiki. Masu aiki ba za su iya samun komai ba, kuma farashin su na iya wuce kowane lada.
depin.safestWorkloadTitle: An gina shi daga mafi aminci na aiki a waje.
depin.safestWorkloadBody: DePin yana ƙara hanyar isar da DeHub na yanzu na farko. Ƙarin buƙatar aiki yana biye ne kawai bayan an tabbatar da tabbatarwa.
depin.deliveryBody: Peer-taimaka kai tsaye da bidiyo bayarwa tare da atomatik fallback.
depin.adaptiveVideoBody: Multiple renditions ga abin dogara sake kunnawa a fadin dangane gudun.
depin.desktopNodesBody: Capped ajiya, bandwidth iko da kuma tabbatar da samuwa.
depin.baseSettlementBody: Kudaden shiga suna da'awar kawai bayan bita na aiki da doka.
depin.faqOfflineQ: Me zai faru lokacin da wani hosting node tafi offline?
depin.faqOfflineA: Mai daidaitawa yana kawar da shi daga motsawa mai aiki. Wani replica hidima bangaren, ko sake kunnawa ya koma ajiyar asalin DeHub yayin da aka tsara kwafin maye gurbin.
depin.faqCanOperatorSeeQ: Shin mai amfani da node zai iya ganin abubuwan da suke karbar bakuncin?
depin.faqCanOperatorSeeA: Ana adana abubuwan da aka kare a matsayin ɓoyayyun ɓangarori kuma mai watsa shiri baya karɓar maɓallan sake kunnawa. Abubuwan da ke cikin jama'a sun kasance a bayyane ta hanyar DeHub ta hanyar zane.
depin.faqHowMuchQ: Nawa ne mai amfani da node zai karbi?
depin.faqHowMuchA: Babu tsayayyen kudi ko tsinkaya. Tabbataccen gudummawa na iya karɓar rabo daga tafkin lada da aka ba da kudaden shiga bayan an rufe wani lokaci. Ba a tabbatar da lada ba, kuma wutar lantarki, bandwidth da farashin kayan aiki na iya wuce kowane lada.
depin.faqSoftwareAvailableQ: Shin software na node yana samuwa yanzu?
depin.faqSoftwareAvailableA: A m, browser tushen tier yana samuwa a yau: shiga da kuma zabi a kan wannan page, kuma ka bude shafin zama node yayin da ya zauna bude. Node mai nauyi, koyaushe a kan tebur shine jagorar da aka bayyana a nan gaba — bai wanzu ba tukuna.
depin.faqInstallNeededQ: Shin ina bukatan shigar da wani abu don node mai bincike?
depin.faqInstallNeededA: A'a. Yana gudanar gaba daya a cikin tab ta amfani da browser ta gida ajiya. Rufe shafin yana dakatar da node ɗinku; babu sabis na baya kuma babu shigarwa.
depin.ctaTitle: Kaddamar kawai lokacin da gazawar ta kasance lafiya.
depin.ctaBody: Origin fallback, encrypted kare kafofin watsa labarai da kuma tabbatar da aiki zo kafin jama'a node lada.
depin.footerNote: Halin shiga DePin sabis ne na bayarwa, ba samfurin saka jari ba. Samuwa, cancanta da ladan na iya canzawa.

commonGround.title: Dandali na gama gari
commonGround.sheetHint: Jinkiri kaɗan kafin amsa ku. Amsa ku ba ta bayyana ga kowa.
commonGround.toggleHint: Kafin amsa ta farko, ana tambayar masu karatu game da mafi muhimmancin batu na ɓangaren gaba da kuma abin da dukkan ɓangarorin ke da shi, sannan a tunatar da su su guji tunanin ko dai-ko-wannan.
commonGround.banner: Wannan mai ƙirƙirar ya kunna yanayin Dandali na gama gari. Kafin ka amsa za a tambaye ka game da mafi muhimmancin batu na ɓangaren gaba da kuma abin da kuke da shi tare.
commonGround.step1Title: A jumla ɗaya, menene mafi muhimmancin batu a ɓangaren gaba?
commonGround.step1Placeholder: Mafi kyawun abin da za su iya faɗi shine cewa…
commonGround.step2Title: Me kuke da su tare da su da gaske kuke yarda a kai?
commonGround.reminderTitle: Yi hankali da tunanin ko dai-ko-wannan
commonGround.reminderBody: Yawancin rashin jituwa ba zaɓi ne tsakanin abubuwa biyu masu tsattsauran ra'ayi ba. Lokacin da tambaya ta zama kamar ko dai-ko-wannan, yawanci akwai wata hanya ta uku a tsakiya.
commonGround.example1: Maƙwabci wanda yake son titin ya yi tsit da maƙwabci wanda yake son wurin ajiye mota na ƙarin motoci dukansu za su iya zama daidai game da abin da suke bukata.
commonGround.example2: Iyaye biyu za su iya rashin jituwa game da lokacin amfani da allo kuma har yanzu su yarda cewa yaron ya kamata ya yi barci sosai kuma ya yi kyau a makaranta.
commonGround.noShouting: Abubuwa masu rikitarwa ba sa samun mafita ta hanyar kururuwa ko barazana. Amsa mai nutsuwa, takamaimi ita ce wadda mutane ke karantawa da gaske.
commonGround.privateNote: Amsa ku ta ku kaɗai ce kuma ba a buga ta tare da amsa ku ba.
commonGround.tooShort: Rubuta aƙalla haruffa 10 don tunani ya ƙidaya da gaske.
commonGround.saveFailed: An kasa adana saitin Dandali na gama gari. Da fatan za a sake gwadawa.

charts.areaModeHint: Yankuna masu ɗorewa da daidaituwa suna nuna kowane jerin a matsayin band. Streamgraphs tsakiya da total a kusa da sifili da kuma boye da reference manufa. Wadannan layouts bukatar nonnegative tushen dabi'u. Nuni na lokaci-lokaci yana riƙe da ƙididdiga na asali a cikin bayanan; yankunan overlapping na iya haɗawa da dabi'u mara kyau.
charts.benchmarkHint: Cika tsayayyen manufa daga duk halin yanzu tushen dabi'u. Aiwatar da layin da aka yi niyya don amfani da shi; sake lissafin bayan gyara bayanan.
charts.brandPaletteHint: Loads a ajiye palette a cikin wannan jadawalin jadawalin. Ajiye palette Stores har zuwa farko goma daban-daban ginshiƙi launuka a Brand styles. Chart dabi'u zauna ba canza.
charts.brandPalettes: Ajiye palettes da launuka na ginshiƙi
charts.bubbleColumnHint: X coordinates zauna a cikin shafi na farko. Kawai shafi na Y da aka zaɓa yana rinjayar ma'auni a tsaye. A size shafi bukatar nonnegative dabi'u da akalla daya tabbatacce darajar; daidai masu girma dabam amfani da naúrar nauyi. Reordering ginshiƙai kiyaye wadannan rawar tare da su data.
charts.bubbleExample: Sauya rubutun tare da misalin kumfa
charts.bubbleHint: Yi amfani da daidaitattun lambobi X a cikin shafi na farko. A cikin yanayin da yawa, zaɓi ginshiƙan Y da girman da ke ƙasa; nakasa suna amfani da jerin farko don Y da na biyu don girman. Yankuna suna daidai da girma; sifili masu girma dabam suna ɓoye. Ba tare da jerin girman ba, kumfa daidai suke. Ƙarin jerin zauna a cikin tushen data. Alamar ƙimar suna nuna Y / girman. Axes da sikelin na iya amfani da kwanakin da lokutan UTC don X.
charts.bubbleSingleColumn: Enable mahara data jerin zabi raba Y da size ginshiƙai. Single-series data amfani daidai kumfa masu girma dabam.
charts.categoryAxisHint: A ajiye kowane bayani tare da ba da tazara tsakanin lakabinsa. Kategori na farko da na karshe su kasance da lakabi. Lakabin da aka karkatar yana amfani da layi daya; a koma 0° don amfani da nade rubutu.
charts.categorySummaryHint: Kowane jerin an taƙaita shi daban. Categories kiyaye sunansu na farko, matsayi da kuma category launi. Row count ƙidaya daidaita tushen layuka a kowane jerin. Yi amfani da Undo draft canji don mayar da asali layuka.
charts.chooseSeries: Sauran manyan data da kuma sauraron da za a yi rubuta.
charts.dateAxisHint: Yi amfani da kwanakin ISO (2026-01-31) ko UTC timestamps (2026-01-31T14:30Z) a cikin shafi na farko na bayanai. Positions nuna elapsed lokaci, ciki har da rata. Kwanan wata da alamun lokaci suna amfani da UTC akan kowane na'ura. Bounds tsawaita ma'auni yayin da yake kiyaye duk bayanan da aka gani.
charts.donutTotalHint: Jimlar ƙididdigar slices masu kyau kuma yana amfani da tsarin ƙimar da aka zaɓa.
charts.filterHint: Dole ne sharuɗɗa uku masu aiki su dace gaba ɗaya. Tace bayanai yana canza jadawalin da aka nuna da fitar da hoto yayin da yake riƙe kowane layin tushe. Ana watsi da matattarar jerin sunaye idan aka cire ko aka sake sunan jerin. Hotunan ci gaba suna riƙe da ƙimar tushensu na farko.
charts.filterText: Rubutun alama da za a daidaita
charts.funnelHint: Matakai suna bin tsarin layi. Yi amfani da ƙimomi marasa korau tare da aƙalla mataki ɗaya mai kyau. Ana gyara launukan mataki, alamomi, da ƙimomi daban.
charts.hierarchyImportHint: Liƙa CSV ko bayanan da aka raba da shafin tare da ginshiƙan rukuni ɗaya zuwa shida da ginshiƙin girman lamba na ƙarshe. Har zuwa layuka 50 suna zama hanyoyin tsarin mulki da aka raba da slash. Dole ne a cika sel na rukuni kuma ba za su iya ƙunsar / ba. Wannan yana maye gurbin bayanan daftarin da jerin guda ɗaya.
charts.histogramFormatHint: Tsarin nuna lamba yana tsara iyakokin kwantena; mitoci suna kasancewa azaman ƙidaya. Ƙananan bayanan ko iri ɗaya suna amfani da ƙarancin kwantena. Iyakar sama tana cikin kwantena na ƙarshe.
charts.intervalsHint: Ƙarin tazara yana ba da ƙarin alamun sikelin; ƙarancin tazara yana sa jadawalin ya fi tsabta. Jadawalin watsawa da kumfa na iya daidaita ma'aunin kwance da tsaye da kansu.
charts.markerHint: Siffofi da tsarin layi suna ba da wata hanyar daban ta bambance jerin bayanai. Maɓallan bayani suna biye da jadawalin. Girman maki sifili yana ɓoye alamomi; girman kumfa yana kiyaye ma'aunin yankin su na da'ira.
charts.missingFilterSeries: Matattara {{filters}} tana nuni ga jerin bayanai da suka ɓace ko marasa tabbas kuma a halin yanzu ana watsi da su.
charts.noBrandPalettes: Ajiye fentin launi a cikin salon Alama (Brand styles) don amfani da shi a nan.
charts.noPictogramIcons: Babu gumaka da suka dace da wannan binciken.
charts.noStarters: Babu farawa da suka dace da wannan binciken.
charts.noTypes: Babu nau'in jadawali da ya dace. Gwada wani bincike ko rukuni daban.
charts.observationHint: Liƙa har zuwa lambobi 50 da aka raba da waƙafi, shafuka ko tsinkewar layi. Wannan yana maye gurbin bayanan da aka tsara da jerin bayanai guda ɗaya. Abubuwan lura na asali suna nan a cikin sel da tushen CSV; ana ƙididdige bins na histogram don nunawa.
charts.orderHint: Dabi'u a kowane jerin suna motsawa tare da nau'ikan su. Launukan nau'in jerin bayanai guda ɗaya suna bin tsari ɗaya.
charts.percentHint: Shigar da maki na kashi: ƙimar 25 tana nuna kamar 25%.
charts.percentStackHint: Kowane nau'i yana nuna rabon kashi. Dabi'u masu kyau da marasa kyau kowannensu ya kai 100% a gefen su na sifili. Dabi'un tushe suna nan a cikin grid ɗin bayanai da zazzagewar CSV.
charts.pictogramRounding: Alamomi suna kiyasta kowane rabo ta amfani da gumaka gabaɗaya. Ƙananan rabo na iya zagayawa zuwa sifili; bayanin yana riƙe da dabi'un tushe. Ƙara jimlar gumaka don ƙarin cikakkun bayanai. Ƙididdigar gunkin ba ta maye gurbin bayanan ku ba.
charts.pieValueHint: Kunna Nuna dabi'u don nuna wannan tsarin. Rabo suna amfani da yanka masu kyau kawai; jimlar tsakiya tana kiyaye tsarin ƙimar ta.
charts.progressColours: Launi na farko na fenti yana cika ci gaba; na biyu yana nuna hanyar da ta rage. Nuna dabi'u yana sarrafa lakabin kashi. Waɗannan jadawalai suna amfani da ƙimar tushe ta farko kawai.
charts.raceAnimate: Rayarwa a cikin tsawon lokacin jadawalin hoto
charts.raceExample: Sauya rubutun tare da misali na matsayi
charts.raceHint: Aikin nazarin bayanan da aka yi da manyan sashi da a cikin kwanakin farko. Bayanan da ke tare da sashi biyu zuwa shida suna cikin kwanakin da suka yi shirin; sunan kowane kwananin shine kujeru. Mafi yawa, mafi girma da mafi girma na bayanan suna da mafi girma. Kungiyoyin suna sake tsayawa a kowane kwananin.
charts.racePosterHint: Har yanzu firam sarrafa SVG da kuma draft previews. Kunna animation kashe don daskare wannan firam a kan jadawalin lokaci ma. An Animated raster da bidiyo fitarwa amfani da playhead lokaci. Duk frames raba wani tsayayyen matsakaicin sikelin.
charts.referenceHint: Manufa tana faɗaɗa ma'aunin ƙima idan ana buƙata. Manufofin da aka tara bisa kashi suna amfani da maki na kashi; sauran manufofi suna amfani da raka'o'in tushe.
charts.sampleColours: Yi amfani da samfurin palette da launi na rubutu

scale.hint: Iyakoki suna faɗaɗa ma'aunin atomatik don ginshiƙan da ke da alaƙa su iya raba kewayon. Ƙimomin da ke wajen waɗancan iyakokin suna kasancewa a bayyane.

charts.scatterHint: Scatter plots amfani da numeric X coordinates a cikin ginshiƙi na farko da kuma Y dabi'u a cikin sauran ginshiƙai. Jerin da yawa suna raba waɗancan haɗin X. Zabi Dates da UTC sau a Axes da sikelin ga elapsed-lokaci kwance axis.

svgPath.hint: Manna hanya d data ko asali SVG alama tare da hanyoyi, rectangles, da'irori, ellipses, Lines da polygons. Motsa, layi, cubic, quadratic, santsi da umarnin arc suna tallafawa. SVG matrix, fassara, sikelin, juyawa da canje-canje na skew suna riƙe da geometry ɗin su. Geometry yana amfani da launi da kuka zaɓa; zane-zane na asali, bugun jini da iyakar viewport ba a shigo da su ba. Curves zama samfurin zane maki. Rufe hanya tare da Z don cika shi. Raba abubuwan SVG da aka rufe za a iya cika su tare. Da yawa sassa zama rukuni editable yadudduka; hadaddun ramukan ba su da goyon baya.

glossary.fractionsDesc: Sakon da aka yi wa minti a DeHub yana zama NFT da aka raba zuwa rabe-rabe 1,000, kuma mai ƙirƙira yana farawa da dukkan 1,000 — mallakar abun ciki 100%. Yin minti na zaɓi ne kuma zai iya faruwa lokacin da kake wallafawa ko daga baya.
glossary.ownershipBarDesc: Sandar ci gaba a shafin Bayanan Saƙo da ke nuna guda nawa daga cikin rabe-rabe 1,000 mai ƙirƙira ke riƙe da su har yanzu da nawa aka rarraba ko aka sayar.
glossary.tokenIdDesc: Keɓaɓɓen mai ganowa a kan blockchain da sako ke samu idan aka yi masa minti a matsayin NFT a kan blockchain. Yin minti na zaɓi ne, don haka sakon da ba a yi wa minti ba tukuna ba shi da Token ID.
glossary.tokenIdInfoDesc: Keɓaɓɓen mai ganowa a kan blockchain da sako ke samu da zarar an yi masa minti a matsayin NFT. Ana nuna shi a saman shafin Bayanin Sako ga sakonnin da aka yi wa minti.
glossary.tipDesc: Aiko da tsabar kuɗin DeHub kai tsaye ga mai ƙirƙirar abun ciki a matsayin kyauta ga abun cikin su. An yi rikodin bayanan a kan blockchain.
glossary.ppvDesc: Abun ciki na musamman wanda ke buƙatar biya a cikin tsabar kuɗin DeHub don buɗewa. Masu ƙirƙirar abun ciki suna saita farashi kuma suna samun kuɗi daga kowane kallo.
glossary.totalTipsDesc: Yana nuna jimillar adadin bayanan da abun ciki ya samu daga masu kallo, wanda aka nuna a shafin bayanan abun ciki.
glossary.listFractionsDesc: Idan kuna mallakar ɓangarorin abun ciki, kuna iya jera su don siyarwa a farashin da kuka saita (a cikin tsabar kuɗi kowace ɓangare). Sauran masu amfani za su iya siyan ɓangarorin ku da aka jera.
glossary.dhbTokenDesc: Tsabar kuɗin amfani na asali na DeHub. DHB shine alamar kasuwanci don tsabar kuɗin DeHub. Ana amfani da shi don bayar da kyauta, abun ciki na biya-kullu-kallo, jefa ƙuri'a na gudanarwa, da saka.
glossary.walletDesc: Walat ɗin ku na kan-chain wanda ke riƙe da tsabar kuɗin DeHub ɗinku da sauran kadarorin crypto. An haɗa ta ta hanyar Web3Auth don sauƙin shiga.
glossary.stakingDesc: Dauke tsabar kuɗin DeHub ɗinku don samun lada akan lokaci. Tsabar kuɗin da aka saka kuma suna ba ku ƙarin ikon jefa ƙuri'a a cikin gudanarwa.
glossary.governanceDesc: Aika da kuma jefa ƙuri'a kan shawarwari waɗanda ke tsara dandalin. Ƙarfin jefa ƙuri'a naku yana da nauyi ta hanyar abubuwan da kuke riƙe na tsabar kuɗin DeHub.
glossary.stakingBadgeDesc: Lambobin yabo da aka nuna kusa da sunan mai amfani ɗinku dangane da jimillar abubuwan da kuke riƙe na tsabar kuɗin DeHub (walat + saka). Akwai matakai 13 — ƙarin tsabar kuɗi da kuke riƙe, mafi girman matsayin lambar yabo ɗinku. Manyan matakai suna ba da ƙarin ikon jefa ƙuri'a na gudanarwa da ƙananan kuɗin dandalin. Ana farashin matsayi a dalar Amurka, don haka adadin tsabar kuɗin da kowannensu ke buƙata yana faɗuwa yayin da farashin tsabar kuɗin ke tashi — kuma da zarar kun sami matsayi, kuna riƙe shi muddin kuna riƙe abin da ya kashe ku, komai yadda farashin ya yi bayan haka.
glossary.badgeRequires: Yana buƙatar tsabar kuɗi {{amount}} · kuɗin dandalin {{fee}}%
glossary.leaderboardRankingDesc: Ana jera masu amfani ta hanyar jimillar ma'auni na tsabar kuɗin DeHub (walat + saka a duk sarƙoƙi). Rankings suna sabuntawa lokaci-lokaci kuma suna lura da canje-canje na kwana 1 da makonni 1. Hakanan zaka iya jera ta ta bayanan da aka aika, bayanan da aka karɓa, masu biyo baya, abubuwan so, ko masu biyan kuɗi.
glossary.thumbsUpDesc: Yana nuna cewa kana son ko ka yarda da wani sako. Yana kara yawan mu'amalar sako kuma yana taimaka masa ya zama na farko a cikin jerin abubuwan da ake gani.
glossary.thumbsDownDesc: Yana nuna cewa ba ka son ko ba ka yarda da wani sako ba. Wannan martanin yana taimakawa wajen inganta shawarwarin abun ciki.
glossary.commentDesc: Bude ɓangaren sharhi inda zaku iya amsawa ga post, shiga tattaunawa, da hulɗa tare da sauran masu amfani.
glossary.shareDesc: Raba post waje ta hanyar hanyar haɗi, ko kwafe URL ɗin post ɗin zuwa clipboard ɗinku don aikawa zuwa wasu.
glossary.bookmarkDesc: Ajiye post zuwa alamomin littafinku don daga baya. Samun dama ga duk rubuce-rubucen da aka ajiye daga shafin Bookmarks a cikin labarun gefe.
glossary.moreOptionsDesc: Bude ƙarin ayyuka kamar gyara, sharewa, ko bayar da rahoton post.
glossary.translateButtonDesc: Fassara post rubutu, bios, da kuma sharhi a cikin harshen da ka fi so. A app auto-detects your browser harshe ko za ka iya saita daya da hannu a Saituna.
glossary.showOriginalDesc: Bayan fassara, danna wannan don komawa zuwa harshen asali na abun ciki.
glossary.imagePostDesc: A post dauke da daya ko fiye images. Ana adana hotuna a kan-chain azaman NFTs tare da ID na Token na musamman.
glossary.videoPostDesc: Rubutun da ke dauke da bidiyo. Ana iya saita bidiyo zuwa ga jama'a, masu zaman kansu, ko biyan kuɗi (PPV).
glossary.liveStreamDesc: A real-lokaci watsa shirye-shirye. Masu kallo iya duba, sharhi, da tip da streamer. Streams amfani da low-latency HLS fasahar.
glossary.storyDesc: Takaitaccen abun ciki na bidiyo wanda ya ƙare bayan sa'o 'i 24. Buga zoben avatar mai amfani a kan abincin gida don duba labarinsu.
glossary.audioDesc: A audio post tare da gani waveform player. Masu kirkiro na iya loda kiɗa, kwasfan fayiloli, ko rikodin murya.
glossary.audioSpaceDesc: Gidan sauti mai rai inda masu amfani zasu iya magana, sauraro, da ɗaga hannayensu don shiga tattaunawar.
glossary.publicDesc: Abubuwan da kowa zai iya gani. Kowa zai iya kallo, ba da "like", da kuma yin sharhi a kan wallafe-wallafen da aka sa a fili.
glossary.subscriberOnlyDesc: Abubuwan da aka takaita ga masu amfani da suka yi rajista ga tashar mahaliccin abun ciki.
glossary.postInfoPageDesc: Cikakken bayani na kowane sako wanda ke nuna bayanan sa na kan yanar gizo (on-chain), ƙididdigar hulɗa, rabon mallaka, da bayanan mahalicci. Ana iya samun damar shiga ta hanyar danna gunkin "ⓘ" a kowane sako.
glossary.txHashInfoDesc: Hash na ma'amalar blockchain daga lokacin da aka ƙirƙiri sakon. Danna shi don buɗe mai binciken tubali (BaseScan ko BscScan) kuma a tabbatar da bayanan da ke kan yanar gizo.
glossary.engagementStatsDesc: Shafin Bayanin Sako yana nuna jimillar abubuwan da aka so (likes), waɗanda ba a so ba (dislikes), ra'ayoyi, sharhi, da kyaututtukan da aka karɓa — yana ba da cikakken hoto na yadda sakon yake tafiya.
glossary.visibilityControlDesc: Masu mallakar sako za su iya canza ganuwar sakon su tsakanin Jama'a (kowa zai iya gani), Wanda ba a jera ba (ta hanyar hanyar haɗi kai tsaye kawai), da Keɓaɓɓe (kai kaɗai). Ana iya samun damar shiga daga shafin Bayanin Sako.
glossary.unlistedDesc: Wani saitin ganuwa inda sakon ba zai bayyana a cikin ciyarwa (feeds) ko bincike ba, amma duk wanda ke da hanyar haɗi kai tsaye zai iya ganin sa.
glossary.editFromInfoDesc: Masu mallakar sako za su iya gyara taken da bayanin sakon su kai tsaye daga shafin Bayanin Sako ta hanyar danna maɓallin gyara.
glossary.ppvPurchasesDesc: Don sakonnin da ake biyan kuɗi don kallo, yana nuna adadin masu amfani da suka sayi damar shiga da jimillar kudaden da mahaliccin ya samu.
glossary.holdersDesc: Jerin adiresoshin walat waɗanda ke mallakar rabon wani sako. Ana nuna su a shafin Bayanin Sako tare da ma'aunin kowane mai mallaka da kashi na mallaka.
glossary.fractionMarketplaceDesc: Shafin kasuwa a shafin Bayanin Sako inda masu riƙe da rabon za su iya jera rabon su don sayarwa kuma masu saye za su iya yin tayi. Yana ba da damar cinikin mallakar abun ciki.
glossary.makeOfferDesc: Gabatar da tayin saye don rabon wani sako a farashin da kuka zaɓa. Mai riƙe da rabon zai iya karɓa ko ƙin amincewa da tayin ku.
glossary.swapDesc: Musanya alama ɗaya da wata kai tsaye a cikin manhajar. Musayar tana faruwa ne a kan sarkar (on-chain) ta amfani da musayar da ba ta da tsakiya (decentralized exchanges).
glossary.txHashDesc: Wani keɓaɓɓen mai gano kowane ma'amala a kan sarkar. Danna shi don ganin cikakkun bayanan ma'amala a kan mai binciken blockchain.
glossary.followers: Masu biyo baya / Masu bin su
glossary.followersDesc: Bi sauran masu amfani don ganin rubuce-rubucensu a cikin shafinka. Adadin masu bin ka yana bayyana a kan bayanin martabarka.
glossary.notificationsDesc: Gargadi don abubuwan da aka so, sharhi, kyauta, biyo baya, da sauran ayyukan da suka shafi asusunka.
glossary.dmDesc: Saƙonnin sirri tsakanin masu amfani. A halin yanzu yana samuwa a kan manhajar wayar hannu tare da tallafin yanar gizo da ke zuwa nan ba da jimawa ba.
glossary.mentionDesc: Yi wa wani mai amfani alama a cikin rubutu ko sharhi ta hanyar buga @ sannan sunan mai amfani da su. Za su karɓi sanarwa.
glossary.homeFeedDesc: Babban shafinka da ke nuna rubuce-rubuce daga mutanen da kake bi da kuma abubuwan da ke tashe.
glossary.exploreDesc: Gano sabbin abubuwan ciki da masu amfani. Bincika ta nau'i: bidiyo, hotuna, watsa shirye-shirye kai tsaye, da ƙari.
glossary.leaderboardDesc: Matsayin manyan masu amfani ta hanyar ma'auni, kyaututtukan da aka aika, kyaututtukan da aka karɓa, masu biyo baya, da ƙari. Ana sabuntawa lokaci-lokaci.
glossary.assistantDesc: Mataimakin hira mai ƙarfin AI wanda zai iya amsa tambayoyi, samar da hotuna, ƙirƙirar bidiyo, da taimakawa tare da fasalulluka na dandamali.
glossary.settingsDesc: Gudanar da abubuwan da kake so na asusu, harshe, saitunan sirri, da bayyanar.

badgeLadder.intro: Kowace matsayi tana da adadin kuɗi na dalar Amurka. Adadin token da ke gefenta shine abin da wannan ke kashewa a farashin tunani na $0.001 — aikace-aikacen yana neman wannan adadi da aka daidaita zuwa farashin rayuwa, kuma ba fiye da shi ba, don haka faɗuwar farashi ba zai iya ƙara mashaya ko dawo da matsayi da ka riga ka samu ba.

postingAllowance.footnote: Maturin lambar yabo shine adadin token na DeHub ɗinka da aka riƙe da kuma saka a kan BNB Chain da Base — daidai balan-balan da aka cire lambar yabonka daga gare ta. Ana farashin tsani a cikin dalar Amurka, don haka adadin token da ke sama shine abin da kowace matsayi ke kashewa a farashin siyarwa na $0.001 kuma buƙatar tana faɗuwa yayin da farashin token ke tashi; matsayi da ka riga ka samu ba a taɓa ɗauke ta ba saboda farashin. Lambar yabo da abokin hulɗa ya ba ka tana bayyana a bayanan martabarka amma ba ta ƙara izinin aika sakonka ba — wannan yana fitowa daga abin da ka riƙe da kanka. Izini suna sake saitawa a 00:00 UTC, kuma gigabyte anan shine 1,024 MB.

getting-started.title: Fara
getting-started.intro: Akwai hanyoyi biyar don shiga DeHub kuma babu ɗayansu da ke buƙatar ka mallaki walat ɗin da: Google, Apple, lambar da aka aika zuwa imel ɗinka, lambar da aka aika ta SMS, ko walat ɗin da kake da shi da ka haɗa. Komai sai hanyar walat ɗin tana ƙirƙirar walat ɗin da ba a kula da shi ba a bayanka — kai ne ke riƙe da maɓallan, kuma DeHub yana ɗaukar nauyin gas ɗin don haka zaka iya yin rubutu, ba da kyauta da tattarawa ba tare da siyan kowane irin tsabar kuɗi ba.

steps.1: Ziyarci dehub.io — feed ɗin gida shine shafi na gaba, don haka zaka iya duba kewaye kafin shiga.
steps.2: Danna 'Sign In'. Zaka ga Google da Apple, wuraren shigar da adireshin imel ko lambar waya, da 'Connect Wallet' don wanda kake da shi.
steps.3: Tare da Google ko Apple, kammala tsarin mai bayarwa. Tare da imel ko SMS, shigar da lambar da ta zo.
steps.4: Ana ƙirƙirar walat kuma ana samar da tsaro a gare ku a farkon shiga. Haɗa walat ɗin ku maimakon haka yana nufin sa hannu ɗaya don tabbatar da adireshin.
steps.5: Zaɓi sunan mai amfani. Shi ne abin da mutane ke gani kuma yana zama hanyar haɗin kai zuwa dehub.io/<username>.
steps.6: Ka shiga. Bincika feed ɗin, saita bayanan martaba, kuma fara yin rubuce-rubuce.

tips.1: Shiga ta hanyar Social, imel da SMS ba sa biyan gas ɗin gas — DeHub yana ɗaukar nauyin sa. Walat ɗin da aka haɗa suna biyan nasu ETH ko BNB.
tips.2: Kuna dawowa zuwa tsohon asusun DeHub? Shiga tare da imel ko lambar waya da ya yi amfani da shi kuma gyaran zai same shi a gare ku.
tips.3: Kuna iya riƙe asusun da dama akan na'ura ɗaya kuma ku canza tsakaninsu a Saiti → Bayanin martaba.

home-feed.title: Feed na Gida
home-feed.intro: Feed ɗin gida shine inda kake ganin rubuce-rubuce daga mutanen da kake bi da kuma abubuwan da ke tasowa. Yana goyan bayan shafuka masu nau'ikan abun ciki da zaɓuɓɓukan tsari.

steps.1: Kewaya zuwa /app — wannan shine feed ɗin gida naka.
steps.2: Yi amfani da shafukan sama don tace ta nau'in abun ciki: Gida (duk), Bidiyo, Hotuna, Shorts, Kiɗa, ko Rayayyun shirye-shirye.
steps.3: Gungura hagu/dama akan shafukan don ganin ƙarin zaɓuɓɓuka akan wayar hannu.
steps.4: Yi amfani da maɓallin tace/tsara (sama-dama na abincin) don canza tsari: Zafi, Sabo, ko Sama.
steps.5: Ja ƙasa don sabunta abincin akan wayar hannu.
steps.6: Yi taɗi ƙasa don lodin ƙarin sakonni ta atomatik (infinite scroll).
steps.7: Canza tsakanin Yanayin Zana da Yanayin Abinci ta amfani da mai canza tsari.

tips.1: Yanayin Zana yana da kyau don duba hotuna da sauri.
tips.2: Shafin 'Gida' yana nuna duk nau'ikan abun ciki da aka haɗa tare.
tips.3: Shafin Rayuwa yana nuna rayayyun shirye-shirye masu aiki a halin yanzu.

creating-posts.title: Ƙirƙirar Sakonni
creating-posts.intro: Ƙirƙiri sakonni na rubutu, raba hotuna, bidiyo, bayanan murya, GIFs, da ƙari. Yi amfani da hashtags, cashtags, da ambaton don ƙara isa.

steps.1: Danna maɓallin 'Sako' a gefen hagu (desktop) ko maɓallin + (wayar hannu).
steps.2: Rubuta rubutunka a wurin rubutu.
steps.3: Don ƙara hoto ko bidiyo, danna gunkin media kuma zaɓi fayil.
steps.4: Don yin rikodin bayanin murya, danna gunkin makirfo.
steps.5: Don ƙara GIF, danna gunkin GIF kuma bincika ɗaya.
steps.6: Yi amfani da #hashtags don rarraba sakonka (misali, #crypto, #defi).
steps.7: Yi amfani da $cashtags don nuna alamun kuɗi (misali, $DHB, $ETH).
steps.8: Yi amfani da @mentions don yiwa wasu masu amfani alama (misali, @username).
steps.9: Danna 'Sako' don bugawa. Sakonka ya bayyana a cikin abincin nan take.

tips.1: Sakonni suna goyan bayan tsarin rubutu mai kama da markdown.
tips.2: Kuna iya sake buga sakonni ta danna gunkin sake bugawa akan kowane sakonni kuma zaɓin 'Quote'.
tips.3: Rukuni (hashtags) suna bayyana a cikin jadawalin 'Talk of the Town'.

interacting-with-posts.title: Bayyanawa da Sakonni
interacting-with-posts.intro: Yi hulɗa da abun ciki ta hanyar jefa ƙuri'a, yin sharhi, ba da kyauta, adanawa, rabawa, da fassara.

steps.1: Jefa kuri'a sama ko ƙasa akan sakonni ta amfani da gunkin kibiya a gefen hagu na kowane sakonni.
steps.2: Danna gunkin sharhi don buɗe sashin sharhi kuma barin amsa.
steps.3: Danna gunkin gem/kyauta don aika kyauta a cikin DeHub tokens ga mai ƙirƙirar sakon.
steps.4: Danna gunkin alamar littafi don adana sakonni don daga baya.
steps.5: Danna gunkin raba don kwafin hanyar haɗin sakon ko raba a waje.
steps.6: Danna maɓallin fassara (alama ta duniya) akan kowane post don fassara rubutu zuwa harshen ku.
steps.7: Don posts na hoto, yi amfani da maɓallin 'Translate Image' don samun sigar da AI ta fassara ta rubutu a cikin hoto.
steps.8: Danna kan kowane post don buɗe shi a cikin cikakken allo guda ɗaya.

tips.1: Bayarwa tana tafiya kai tsaye zuwa walat ɗin mai ƙirƙirar a cikin DeHub tokens.
tips.2: Kuna iya saita adadin bayarwa ta hanyar maɓallan zaɓi mai sauri ko shigar da adadi na musamman.
tips.3: Posts da aka yiwa alama ana iya samun su daga shafin Alamar a gefen gefe.

explore-search.title: Bincike & Neman
explore-search.intro: Gano sabon abun ciki da masu amfani ta hanyar shafin bincike da ingantaccen aikin bincike.

steps.1: Jeka /app/explore daga gefen gefe.
steps.2: Yi amfani da mashaya bincike a sama don bincika masu amfani, posts, ko abun ciki.
steps.3: Tace sakamako ta tab: Duk, Mutane, Posts, Hotuna, Bidiyo, Kiɗa, Kai tsaye.
steps.4: Binciko batutuwa masu tasowa da nau'ikan akan shafin bincike.
steps.5: Danna kan batun da ke tasowa don ganin duk posts masu alaƙa.
steps.6: Danna kan mai amfani a cikin sakamakon bincike don ziyarci bayanan martabarsa.

tips.1: Bincike yana goyan bayan sunayen masu amfani, adireshin walat, da kalmomin binciken abun ciki.
tips.2: Batutuwa masu tasowa suna sabuntawa dangane da ayyukan bugawa na baya-bayan nan.

profile.title: Bayani
profile.intro: Bayanan martabarka tana nuna posts ɗinka, masu biyo baya, masu biyo baya, da bayanin walat.

steps.1: Danna avatar ɗinka ko 'Profile' a gefen gefe don duba bayanan martabarka.
steps.2: Danna 'Edit Profile' don sabunta sunan nuni, bio, da avatar ɗinka.
steps.3: Loda hoton bayanin martaba ta danna avatar ɗinka a yanayin gyara.
steps.4: Duba ƙididdigar masu biyo baya da masu biyo baya akan shafin bayanan martabarka.
steps.5: Binciko posts ɗinka, kafofin watsa labarai, da abun ciki da kuka so ta hanyar shafukan bayanan martaba.
steps.6: Kwafi adireshin walat ɗinka ta danna alamar kwafi kusa da shi.
steps.7: Ziyarci bayanan martabar wasu masu amfani ta danna sunan mai amfani ko avatar ɗinsu a ko'ina a dandalin.

tips.1: Sunan mai amfani naka na musamman ne kuma yana bayyana a cikin URL na bayanan martabarka (dehub.io/@username).
tips.2: Saitunan sirri suna ba ka damar sarrafa ko wanene zai iya ganin ƙididdigar masu biyo baya.

messages.title: Saƙonni
messages.intro: aika saƙonni kai tsaye ga wasu masu amfani a dandalin.

steps.1: Danna 'Messages' a gefen gefe don buɗe shafin saƙonni.
steps.2: Danna maballin rubutu don fara sabuwar tattaunawa.
steps.3: Nemo mai amfani ta sunan sa don aika masa saƙo.
steps.4: Rubuta saƙonka kuma danna aika.
steps.5: Duba tarihin tattaunawarka a jerin saƙonni.
steps.6: Danna kan tattaunawa don ci gaba da yin hira.

tips.1: Za ku sami sanarwa lokacin da wani ya yi muku saƙo.
tips.2: Masu kirkira za su iya kulle saƙonni ta hanyar buƙatar kuɗi.

ai-assistant.title: Mataimakin AI
ai-assistant.intro: Yi hira da mataimakin AI na DeHub don samun taimako, bayanai, da ayyukan kirkira.

steps.1: Danna 'Mataimaki' a gefen gefe don buɗe hira ta AI.
steps.2: Rubuta tambayarka ko buƙatarka a cikin shigarwar hira.
steps.3: AI na iya taimakawa tare da bayanan crypto, tambayoyin dandalin, da ilimin gaba ɗaya.
steps.4: Fara sabuwar tattaunawa ta danna maballin sabuwar hira.
steps.5: Duba tarihin tattaunawarka a gefen gefe na shafin mataimaki.
steps.6: Kuna iya haɗa hotuna don AI ta bincika.

tips.1: AI tana tuna mahallin a cikin tattaunawa.
tips.2: Kuna iya tambayar AI game da fasalulluka na DeHub, sharuɗɗan crypto, ko tambayoyi na gaba ɗaya.
tips.3: Tsofaffin tattaunawa ana adana su kuma ana iya samun su kowane lokaci.

notifications.title: Sanarwa
notifications.intro: Rage sabuntawa tare da abubuwan so, sharhi, kuɗi, biyo baya, da sauran ayyuka akan abubuwan da kuka kirkira.

steps.1: Danna gunkin kararrawa ko 'Sanarwa' a gefen gefe.
steps.2: Duba duk sanarwa a cikin jerin lokaci.
steps.3: Danna kan sanarwa don kewaya zuwa abin da ya dace.
steps.4: Sanarwa sun haɗa da: sabbin masu biyo baya, zaɓen post, sharhi, kuɗi, da ambaton.
steps.5: Sanarwa da ba a karanta ba ana nuna su — suna alama a matsayin an karanta lokacin da aka gani.

tips.1: Alamar sanarwa tana nuna adadin sanarwa da ba a karanta ba.
tips.2: Sanarwar kuɗi tana nuna adadin kuɗin da kuka samu.

wallet.title: Walat
wallet.intro: Duba kuɗin ku na DeHub a kan sarƙoƙi da yawa, duba ajiyar staking, da sarrafa kadarorinku.

steps.1: Danna 'Wallet' a gefen gefe don buɗe shafin wallet.
steps.2: Duba jimillar kuɗin ku na token da aka tattara a duk sarƙoƙi da aka tallafa.
steps.3: Duba rarrabuwa ta kowane sarƙoƙi: Ethereum, Base, BNB Chain, da ƙari.
steps.4: Duba ajiyar ku na staking da ladan ku.
steps.5: Danna 'Refresh Scan' don sabunta kuɗin ku daga bayanan kan-sarƙoƙi.
steps.6: Kwafin adireshin walat ɗin ku don karɓar kuɗi daga wasu.

tips.1: Kuɗi suna sabuntawa ta atomatik amma kuna iya tilasta sabuntawa kowane lokaci.
tips.2: Walat ɗin yana nuna duka kuɗi masu ruwa (a hannu) da kuma kuɗin da aka yi staking.

staking.title: Tashin hankali
staking.intro: Yi staking na kuɗin ku na DeHub don samun lada da kuma ƙara ikon ku na zaɓe a mulki.

steps.1: Je zuwa shafin 'Staking' daga gefen hagu.
steps.2: Shigar da adadin kuɗin da kake son yi wa staking.
steps.3: Zaɓi sarƙoƙin da kake son yi wa staking a kai.
steps.4: Tabbatar da ciniki a cikin walat ɗin ku (walat na waje) ko kuma yana sarrafa kansa (shiga ta zamantakewa).
steps.5: Duba adadin ku na staking da duk wani lada da ke jiran ku.
steps.6: Don cire staking, shigar da adadin kuma tabbatar da cinikin cire staking.

tips.1: Staking yana ƙara nauyin zaɓen ku a cikin shawarwarin mulki.
tips.2: Masu amfani da Social-login ba sa buƙatar gas don yin staking — yana da gasless.
tips.3: Kuna iya yin staking a kan sarƙoƙi da yawa a lokaci guda.

leaderboard.title: Jagora
leaderboard.intro: Gani waye ke kan gaba! Leaderboard yana jera masu amfani ta hanyar kuɗi, kashe kuɗi na yau da kullun, da kuma batutuwan da ke tasowa.

steps.1: Je zuwa shafin 'Leaderboard' daga gefen hagu.
steps.2: Canza tsakanin shafuka: Balance, Daily Spent, da Talk of the Town.
steps.3: Shafin Balance yana jera masu amfani ta hanyar jimillar kuɗin ku na token.
steps.4: Shafin Daily Spent yana nuna wanda ya fi aiki wajen ba da kuɗi a cikin awanni 24 da suka gabata.
steps.5: Talk of the Town yana nuna batutuwa/rukuni mafi muhawara.
steps.6: Danna kan kowane mai amfani don ziyarci bayanan sa.
steps.7: Leaderboard yana sabuntawa lokaci-lokaci a duk tsawon yini.

tips.1: Jerin na yau da kullun suna sake saitawa kowane awanni 24.
tips.2: Talk of the Town yana lura da rukuni na kalma ɗaya daga hashtags.

command-centre.title: Cibiyar Umarni
command-centre.intro: Bayanin dashboard da ke nuna muhimman ma'auni da ayyukan dandalinku a kallo.

steps.1: Danna 'Command Centre' a gefen mashaya.
steps.2: Duba taƙaitaccen bayanin martabarku, gami da yawan abubuwan da kuka yi, masu biyanku, da kuma hulɗa.
steps.3: Duba ayyukan da kuka yi kwanan nan da kuma batutuwan da ke tasowa.
steps.4: Samun hanyoyin haɗi masu sauri zuwa fasalulluka da ake amfani da su akai-akai.

tips.1: Command Centre yana baku damar ganin DeHub ɗin ku gaba ɗaya.

governance.title: Gudanarwa
governance.intro: Shiga cikin gudanarwar dandalin ta hanyar ƙirƙirar tayi da kuma zaɓen shawarwarin al'umma.

steps.1: Je zuwa 'Governance' daga gefen mashaya.
steps.2: Bincika tayi masu aiki da al'umma suka gabatar.
steps.3: Danna tayi don karanta cikakken bayani da tattaunawarsu.
steps.4: Zaɓi tayi ta amfani da maɓallan thumbs up/down — nauyin zaɓinku ya dogara da adadin DeHub tokens da kuka ajiye.
steps.5: Bar sharhi akan tayi don tattaunawa da al'umma.
steps.6: Gabatar da tayinku ta hanyar danna maɓallin 'Create Proposal'.

tips.1: Ƙarfin zaɓinku ana ƙididdige shi ta adadin tokens da kuka ajiye.
tips.2: Masu rike da Badge na iya samun ƙarin nauyin zaɓe.
tips.3: Tayi suna wuce ta matakai: Aiki → Wucewa/Karyewa.

bookmarks.title: Alamomi
bookmarks.intro: Ajiye abubuwan da kuka yi a cikin alamominku don samun sauƙin samun su daga baya.

steps.1: Danna alamar alamar akan kowane abin da kuka yi don adana shi.
steps.2: Je zuwa 'Bookmarks' a gefen mashaya don duba duk abubuwan da kuka adana.
steps.3: Danna abin da aka yiwa alama don duba shi gaba ɗaya.
steps.4: Cire alama ta hanyar danna alamar alamar sake.

tips.1: Alamomi sirri ne — ku kaɗai za ku iya ganin abubuwan da kuka adana.
tips.2: Babu iyaka ga adadin abubuwan da za ku iya yiwa alama.

settings.title: Saituna
settings.intro: Tsara ƙwarewar DeHub ɗinku tare da harshe, sirri, da zaɓuɓɓukan nuni.

steps.1: Danna 'Settings' a gefen mashaya.
steps.2: Canza harshen nuni daga zaɓin harshe.
steps.3: Gyara saitunan sirri: sarrafa wanene zai ga adadin masu biyanku da jerin abubuwan da kuke bi.
steps.4: Saita zaɓin bayyanar bayanan ku na tsoho.
steps.5: Gudanar da zaɓin sanarwa.

tips.1: DeHub yana goyan bayan harsuna da yawa — duk abin da ke cikin shafin yana fassara.
tips.2: Saitunan sirri suna aiki nan take.

posting-allowance.title: Yawan Bayanan Ku na Rana
posting-allowance.intro: Bayarwa kyauta ce kowace rana har zuwa iyaka wanda ke girma tare da lambar yabo ta staking ɗin ku. Kowace mutum yana farawa da bayanan rubutu goma da gigabyte ɗaya na bidiyo, hotuna da odiyo kowace rana. Wuce ɗaya daga cikin waɗannan kuma sauran wannan ranar ana biyan su da kuɗin DeHub — kawai akan ɓangaren da ya wuce iyaka.

steps.1: Yi bayani kamar yadda aka saba. A cikin iyaka babu abin da ake caji kuma babu abin da ake tambaya daga gare ku.
steps.2: Bayanan rubutu da kafofin watsa labarai rukunin raba ne, don haka yinin da aka ciyar da loda bidiyo har yanzu yana barin duk bayanan rubutu goma kyauta.
steps.3: Lokacin da wani bayani zai wuce iyaka, aikace-aikacen yana ƙididdige shi da farko kuma yana duba walat ɗin ku zai iya rufe shi kafin komai ya loda.
steps.4: Bayanan yana bugawa kamar yadda yake a cikin iyaka — bugawa ba ta jira biya ba.
steps.5: Sannan kuna amincewa da canja wuri ɗaya don wannan bayanin kawai, wanda aka tsai da shi akan wanne daga cikin Base ko BNB Chain ke da isassun kuɗin DeHub.
steps.6: Duk rukunin suna sake saitawa da tsakar dare UTC.

tips.1: Wucewa yana daidai da yawa: 200 MB da ya wuce iyaka yana kashe 200 MB, ba duka gigabyte ɗaya ba.
tips.2: Sake bugawa, sharhi, martani, ba da kuɗi da saƙonni ba su da tsada kuma ba sa taɓa iyaka.
tips.3: Karyata biyan kuɗin kuma bayanin ya kasance — adadin yana toshe bayanin ku na gaba da za a biya har sai an tsai da shi. Iyakacin kyauta na gobe koyaushe naku ne.
tips.4: Alamar staking tana haɓaka iyaka kyauta kuma tana rage farashin duk abin da ya wuce shi.

reactions-and-safety.title: Martani, Rushewa & Abubuwan da Ba su Dace ba
reactions-and-safety.intro: Akwai martani tara a bayan maɓallin kamar; da kuma saitin sarrafawa don yanke hukunci kan abin da kuke gani da kuma wanene zai iya samun ku.

steps.1: Riƙe yatsa sama akan kowane bayani don buɗe tire na martani: kamar, so, girmamawa, zafi, lol, baƙin ciki, kuka, rashin so da najasa.
steps.2: Tushen bakwai masu kyau suna ƙidaya zuwa jimlar son bayanin; rashin so da najasa suna ƙidaya a kansa.
steps.3: Martanin ku yana da nauyi ta lambar yabo ta staking ɗin ku, don haka martanin mai riƙe da lambar yabo yana motsa ƙididdigar fiye da kaɗa ɗaya.
steps.4: Danna X a cikin kan bayanin don toshe marubucinsa — suna fita daga abincin ku nan take.
steps.5: Masu ƙirƙirar suna yiwa bayanan su alama a matsayin manya yayin da suke tsarawa; waɗannan bayanan suna kasancewa a waje da shafin gida na jama'a.
steps.6: Don ganin manyan bayanan ko'ina, kunna 'Nuna abubuwan da ba su dace ba' a Saituna.

tips.1: Babban bayani har yanzu yana da cikakken bayani akan bayanin mai ƙirƙira da kuma ga mutanen da ke bin sa.
tips.2: Tsayawa daga bayanin ya fi toshewa nisa kuma yana yanke saƙon ma.
tips.3: Tire na martani yana nuna wanda ya yi martani da abin da, don haka zaku iya ganin dakin maimakon lambobi kawai.

stages.title: Matakai (Dakunan Odiyo Kai tsaye)
stages.intro: Matakai dakunan odiyo ne kai tsaye da aka gina a cikin DeHub. Mai watsa labarai yana buɗe daki, yana kawo masu magana sama, kuma kowa na iya shiga don sauraro daga shafin Matakai ko hanyar haɗin da aka raba.

steps.1: Bude 'Matakai' a cikin sandar gefe don ganin abin da ke gudana yanzu da abin da aka tsara.
steps.2: Danna wani mataki kai tsaye don shiga a matsayin mai sauraro, ko saita tuni a kan wanda aka tsara kuma a gaya maka lokacin da ya fara.
steps.3: Fara naku daga shafi ɗaya — za ku iya zuwa kai tsaye daga burauza, ba tare da OBS ko maɓallin watsawa ba.
steps.4: A matsayinka na mai masauki, kawo masu magana a kan mataki, ka kashe ko ka cire su, ka raba allonka, kuma ka sarrafa allon sauti.
steps.5: Masu sauraro suna aika martani kai tsaye kuma suna magana a cikin tattaunawar ɗakin ba tare da zuwa kan mataki ba.
steps.6: Kowane mataki yana yin rikodin, kuma rikodin yana sake kunnawa bayan haka daga katin da ya bayyana a kai.

tips.1: Kallon kai tsaye yana ba da rubutu ga kowane mai magana kuma yana fassara zuwa kowace harshe da kake karantawa a ciki.
tips.2: Fassarar kai tsaye na iya magana da ɗakin da babbar murya ta mai masauki ta mallakar murya, ana biyan kuɗi ta minti a cikin kuɗin DeHub.
tips.3: Masu masauki za su iya sanya tashar rediyo ta watsawa ko kunna waƙoƙin nasu tsakanin tattaunawa.
tips.4: Ƙaramin ɗan wasa yana ci gaba da ɗakin a kusurwa yayin da kake bincika sauran aikace-aikacen.

communities.title: Kungiyoyi & Abubuwan da suka faru
communities.intro: Kungiyoyi wuraren da membobi ke gudanarwa tare da nasu abinci, membobi da ayyuka. Abubuwan da suka faru suna ƙara tsarin da aka tsara lokaci a saman su.

steps.1: Bude 'Kungiyoyi' a gefen hagu kuma bincika na jama'a.
steps.2: Shiga cikin danna ɗaya. Sabon aiki yana bayyana a matsayin alamar da ba a karanta ba a cikin kewayawa.
steps.3: Yi post, tattauna, gudanar da zaɓe kuma ba da kyauta a cikin abincin kowace kungiya.
steps.4: Masu mallakar kungiya suna sarrafa sararin su kuma za su iya ba da izinin gudanarwa ga wasu.
steps.5: Bude 'Abubuwan da suka faru' don tsarin da aka tsara, tare da cikakken shafi ga kowane taron da za ku iya bi da shi kai tsaye.

tips.1: Tattaunawar kungiya tana goyan bayan @mentions da @here, don haka post zai iya isa ga dakin.
tips.2: Hanyar gayyata tana ba ka damar kawo mutane kai tsaye cikin kungiya.

arcade.title: Arcade
arcade.intro: Wasanni biyar suna gudana a cikin DeHub a cikin shafin burauza — babu abin da za a shigar, babu abin da za a saya.

steps.1: Bude 'Arcade' a gefen hagu.
steps.2: Zaɓi wasa: King's Gambit (3D chess tare da kan layi Elo ladder), Claude of Duty (mai harbi wanda ke samar da nasa fasaha yayin da yake lodawa), Jungle Trail (procedural rainforest walk), Street Slayer (beat 'em up da aka yi don DeHub) ko Chartopia (wurin ciniki mai tafiya).
steps.3: Yi wasa a cikin shafin. King's Gambit da Street Slayer suna riƙe da jadawalin jagoranci.
steps.4: Chartopia kuma yana gudana a cikin VR headset ta hanyar WebXR.

tips.1: Biyu daga cikinsu suna ɓoye a cikin jigogin bayyanar — saita aikace-aikacen zuwa War don Claude of Duty, ko Jungle don Jungle Trail.
tips.2: Kowane wasa yana da nasa katin raba, don haka hanyar haɗi zuwa ɗaya yana buɗewa yadda ya kamata a duk inda ka aika shi.

bounties-stores.title: Bounties & Stores
bounties-stores.intro: Hanyoyi biyu don juya dandalin zuwa samun kuɗi: aika ko karɓar kyauta, ko buɗe kantin sayar da sayarwa ga masu sauraron ku.

steps.1: Bude 'Bounties' don bincika buɗaɗɗen aiki, ta hanyar nau'i ko kuɗi.
steps.2: Karɓi ɗaya, yi aikin, kuma ka aika shi don tattara lada — kowa na iya zama mai farauta, ba a buƙatar aikace-aikace.
steps.3: Saka kyautarka tare da taƙaitaccen bayani da kuma ladan kuɗi a cikin DeHub ko USDC. Yana shiga cikin ajiyar kuɗi a lokacin da kuka sanya shi.
steps.4: Bude 'Stores' don kafa shagon sayarwa tare da shafinsa, alamarsa, da kuma jeri.
steps.5: Ana tsara farashin samfurori kuma ana biya su a cikin kuɗin DeHub ta hanyar walat ɗin da aka gina, ba tare da wani tsarin biya na waje ba.

tips.1: An tsara kyaututtuka zuwa Social Media, Clipping, da kuma Contracts.
tips.2: Hanyar jayayya tana warware rashin fahimta kan bayarwa, don haka ajiyar kuɗi koyaushe tana warwarewa cikin adalci.
tips.3: Masu kirkira suna amfani da kyaututtuka don haɓaka al'umma — rabawa, gajerun shirye-shirye, da kuma martani duk ayyuka ne masu inganci.

creator-studio.title: Creator Studio & Editor
creator-studio.intro: Creator Studio yana samar da hotuna, bidiyo, kiɗa, murya, da kuma samfuran 3D daga bayani, kuma yana ba su ga edita — gami da cikakken editan bidiyo mai yawa wanda ke gudana a cikin burauzar.

steps.1: Bude Creator Studio kuma ka bayyana abin da kake so a yi.
steps.2: Server ɗin yana ba da farashin kafin aikin ya gudana, don haka ka ga abin da yake kashewa kafin ka kashe shi.
steps.3: Renders suna ci gaba a cikin jerin abubuwa da aka raba yayin da kake ci gaba da bincika app ɗin.
steps.4: Tsara sakamakon a cikin editan salon Canva, ko bude editan bidiyo don layin lokaci na gaske tare da yanke, layering, da kuma fitarwa.
steps.5: Sanya abin da aka gama kai tsaye cikin wani post, gajeren bidiyo, ko jeri na shago.

tips.1: Wani ɗakin ajiya na kyauta yana zaune kusa da Studio don duk abin da kake so ka guji samarwa.
tips.2: Ana biyan samarwa a cikin kuɗin DeHub daga walat ɗinka — kana sanya hannu kan canja wuri ɗaya ga kowane aiki, kuma ana ba da farashin kafin ka biya.
tips.3: Masu amfani masu nauyi za su iya ɗaukar Ultra, Team, ko Scale plan, wanda ke aika kuɗin kuɗi na wata-wata kai tsaye zuwa walat ɗinsu.

buying-dhb.title: Siyan Kuɗi
buying-dhb.intro: Siyan kuɗin DeHub kai tsaye a cikin app ta amfani da tsarin musayar da aka gina.

steps.1: Je zuwa shafin 'Buy' daga sandar gefe.
steps.2: Zaɓi kuɗin da kake son musanyawa daga (misali, ETH, USDC).
steps.3: Shigar da adadin da kake son kashewa ko adadin kuɗin da kake son samu.
steps.4: Duba ƙimar musayar da kuma kimanin fitarwa.
steps.5: Danna gunkin gear na saituna don daidaita ƙimar haɗari (default shine 1%).
steps.6: Tabbatar da cinikin musayar.
steps.7: Kuɗin DeHub za su bayyana a cikin walat ɗinka bayan cinikin ya kammala.

tips.1: Babban ƙimar haɗari = mafi yiwuwa a aiwatarwa, amma yuwuwar samun farashi mara kyau.
tips.2: Koyaushe duba ƙimar musayar kafin tabbatarwa.
tips.3: Kuna iya saita haɗari na musamman a cikin kwamitin saituna.

bridge.title: Gada
bridge.intro: Matsar da kuɗin DeHub ɗinka tsakanin blockchains masu goyan baya ta amfani da giciye-giciye na bridge.

steps.1: Je ka je zuwa shafin 'Bridge' daga gefen gefe.
steps.2: Zaɓi tushen sarkar (inda kuɗin ku suke a yanzu).
steps.3: Zaɓi sarkar da za a nufa (inda kake son aika su).
steps.4: Shigar da adadin kuɗin da za a yi garkuwa.
steps.5: Duba kuɗin garkuwa da kuma lokacin da ake sa ran isowa.
steps.6: Tabbatar da cinikin garkuwa.
steps.7: Ƙungiyar tana aika tokens ɗin a kan sarkar da za a kai, yawanci cikin kwanakin aiki 1-5.

tips.1: Kuɗin garkuwa na bambanta ta hanyar sarkar ma'aurata.
tips.2: A yanzu ana biyan kuɗin gada da hannu.
tips.3: Koyaushe duba sarkar da za a nufa kafin tabbatarwa.

music-tv.title: Kiɗa & TV
music-tv.intro: Ji daɗin abun ciki na kafofin watsa labarai kai tsaye a cikin DeHub — kunna kiɗa da kallon tashoshin TV kai tsaye.

steps.1: Je zuwa 'Music' daga gefen gefe don bincika da kunna bayanan kiɗa.
steps.2: Je zuwa 'TV' don samun damar tashoshin TV kai tsaye.
steps.3: Bincika tashoshi ta rukuni ko ƙasa.
steps.4: Danna kan tashar don fara kallo.
steps.5: Yi amfani da sarrafawar ƴan wasa don daidaita ƙarar da sake kunnawa.
steps.6: Bayar da rahoton tashoshin da suka lalace ta amfani da maballin rahoto.

tips.1: Tashoshin TV ana tabbatar da su ta al'umma don amintaka.
tips.2: Ana iya kunna bayanan kiɗa yayin binciken wasu abubuwan ciki.

post-info.title: Bayanan Post & Ƙididdiga
post-info.intro: Post da aka haƙa shine NFT da aka raba zuwa 1,000 ɓangarori. Shafin Bayanan Post yana nuna bayanai akan sarkar, ƙididdigar shiga, rarraba mallaka, kuma yana ba ka damar ciniki da ɓangarori na kowane post — akan post da ba a haƙa ba yana bayar da haƙawa maimakon.

steps.1: Danna alamar 'ⓘ' akan kowane post don buɗe shafin Bayanan Post ɗinsa.
steps.2: A saman za ku ga Lambar Token (mai ganowa na musamman akan sarkar) da kuma hash na ciniki — danna hash don ganin shi akan mai binciken block.
steps.3: A ƙasa, ƙididdigar shiga suna nuna jimlar abubuwan so, abubuwan rashin so, kallon, sharhi, da kuma tips da aka karɓa.
steps.4: Sashen masu riƙe yana nuna mashaya ci gaba na yawan ɓangarori 1,000 da mai ƙirƙira har yanzu yake mallaka, ƙari ga jerin duk masu riƙe da ɓangarori tare da kuɗin su da kuma kashi.
steps.5: Idan post ɗin yana biya-kullum-kallo (PPV), za ku ga farashi, kuɗi, da kuma yawan masu amfani da suka saya.
steps.6: Masu mallakar post na iya canza ganuwa (Jama'a, Ba a jera ba, ko Sirri) da kuma gyara taken/bayani kai tsaye daga wannan shafi.

tips.1: Sabon post da aka haƙa yana farawa da mai ƙirƙira yana riƙe da dukkan ɓangarori 1,000 (mallakar 100%).
tips.2: Hash na ciniki yana haɗawa zuwa BaseScan ko BscScan dangane da sarkar.
tips.3: Posts da ba a jera su ba suna bayyana a cikin abinci amma har yanzu ana iya samun su ta hanyar hanyar haɗi kai tsaye.

buying-fractions.title: Siyan Rabin Rabin
buying-fractions.intro: Kuna iya siyan rabin kowane post don mallakar wani yanki na wannan abun ciki. Cinikin rabin yana faruwa akan shafin kasuwa na shafin Bayanin Post.

steps.1: Bude shafin Bayanin Post don post da kake sha'awa (danna alamar 'ⓘ').
steps.2: Canza zuwa shafin 'Kasuwanci' don ganin jeri da tayi da ake samu.
steps.3: Bincika jeri na rabin – kowane jeri yana nuna mai siyarwa, adadi, farashi kowane rabi, da jimillar kuɗi a cikin DeHub tokens.
steps.4: Danna 'Yi Tayi' don aika tayin siyan akan farashin da kuka zaɓa.
steps.5: Shigar da adadin rabin da kuke so da farashin kowane rabi a cikin DeHub tokens.
steps.6: Tabbatar da tayin ku – mai riƙe da rabin zai iya karɓa ko ƙin yarda da shi.
steps.7: Da zarar an karɓa, rabin suna canzawa zuwa walat ɗin ku kuma ana aika tokens ɗin zuwa mai siyarwa.

tips.1: Duba jerin masu riƙe don ganin rarraba mallaka na yanzu kafin siye.
tips.2: Mallakar rabin post yana nufin kuna riƙe da wani yanki na wannan NFT ɗin akan-chain.
tips.3: Farashin rabin masu siyarwa ne ke saita su – bincika don samun mafi kyawun yarjejeniyoyi.

selling-fractions.title: Siyar da Rabin
selling-fractions.intro: Idan kuna mallakar rabin post (a matsayin mai ƙirƙira ko ta hanyar siye), zaku iya jera su don siyarwa akan kasuwa.

steps.1: Bude shafin Bayanin Post don post da kuke mallakar rabin sa.
steps.2: Canza zuwa shafin 'Kasuwanci'.
steps.3: Danna maɓallin 'Jera Rabin' (yana bayyana ne kawai idan kuna riƙe da rabin).
steps.4: Shigar da adadin rabin da kuke son siyarwa.
steps.5: Saita farashin ku na kowane rabi a cikin DeHub tokens.
steps.6: Duba jimillar ƙimar jeri kuma tabbatar.
steps.7: Yanzu an jera rabin ku – sauran masu amfani za su iya siyan su ko yin tayin akasin haka.

tips.1: Kuna iya jera kowane adadi har zuwa jimillar rabin ku.
tips.2: Ana iya soke jeri kafin wani ya saya.
tips.3: A matsayinka na mai ƙirƙira, siyar da rabin yana bawa magoya baya damar mallakar abun cikin ku tare.

minting-posts.title: Saka Posts (Ƙirƙirar NFTs)
minting-posts.intro: Saka yana da zaɓi. Post yana bugawa off-chain a lokacin da kuka aika shi – babu walat, babu sa hannu, babu gas – kuma zaku iya saka shi azaman NFT duk lokacin da kuke so, ko dai yayin da kuke tsarawa ko kuma daga baya daga post ɗin kansa.

steps.1: Danna maɓallin 'Post' a cikin mashaya gefe (desktop) ko maɓallin + (wayar hannu).
steps.2: Rubuta rubutun ku, haɗa kafofin watsa labarai (hotuna, bidiyo, sauti), kuma ƙara nau'ikan.
steps.3: Bar 'Saka post' a kashe don bugawa off-chain, ko kunna shi don saka yayin da kuke bugawa.
steps.4: Bugawa ba ya jira a kan sarkar: post ya bayyana a cikin ciyar ko ta yaya.
steps.5: Don yin mint a gaba, buɗe shafin bayanin 'ⓘ' na rubutun kuma ka yi amfani da aikin Mint a can.
steps.6: Da zarar minted, da post samun Token ID da kuma ma'amala hash za ka iya tabbatar a kan-chain, kuma ka rike duk 1,000 sassa na shi.

tips.1: Social, imel da SMS sa hannu-ins biya sifili gas — DeHub tallafawa minting kudade.
tips.2: Masu amfani da-wallet na waje suna buƙatar ETH akan Base ko BnB akan Sarkar BnB don iskar gas.
tips.3: Minting shi ne abin da ya sa post ciniki da kuma royalty-bearing. Rubutun da ba a buga ba har yanzu yana samun nasihu da ra'ayoyi.
tips.4: A kan-chain rikodin ne na dindindin da zarar minted, ko da idan post ne daga baya share daga ciyar.

glossary.title: Kamus
glossary.intro: A m glossary na crypto da kuma dandamali terminology ya taimake ka kewaya Web3.

steps.1: Kewaya zuwa 'Glossary' daga gefen gefe.
steps.2: Browse sharuddan haruffa ko amfani da bincike don nemo takamaiman sharuddan.
steps.3: Danna kan kalma don ganin cikakken ma'anarsa da bayani.
steps.4: Sharuɗɗa suna rufe ra'ayoyin crypto, DeFi terminology, da kuma siffofin DeHub na musamman.

tips.1: Babban albarkatu ga sababbin shiga zuwa crypto da Web3.
tips.2: Ana sabunta glossary akai-akai tare da sababbin sharuɗɗa.

accountDeletion.title: Share wannan Asusun
accountDeletion.description: Kullum share asusunka da bayanan sirri
accountDeletion.warning: Wannan zai share bayanan martabarka na DeHub, rubuce-rubuce, sharhi, saƙonni da ajiyayyen walat ɗinka har abada. Ka adana bayanan dawo da walat ɗinka kuma ka fara matsar da duk wata kadara. Ba za a iya share mu'amalolin blockchain na jama'a da bayanan biyan kuɗi da doka ta buƙata ba. Ana ɓoye bayananka nan take; sharewa tana kammala cikin kwanaki 30. Ba za a iya mayar da wannan ba.
accountDeletion.receipt: An adana buƙatarku na sharewa. Bayaninka yana ɓoye kuma za a share asusunka har abada a cikin kwanaki 30. Shiga ciki ba zai iya soke wannan buƙatar ba.
accountDeletion.error: Ba zai iya gabatar da buƙatarku na sharewa ba. Ba a tabbatar da asusunka don sharewa ba. Don Allah a sake gwadawa.
accountDeletion.acknowledge: Na ajiye ta walat dawo da cikakkun bayanai da kuma fahimtar cewa shafewa ne na dindindin.

dev.notifyBody: Masu amfani waɗanda ke ƙara aikace-aikacenku za a iya sanar da su daga uwar garken ku tare da maɓallin sanarwar ku. Babu alamun per-user don adanawa.
dev.rankTitle: Ta yaya kantin sayar da martaba apps
dev.rankBody: Kowace dare kowane aikace-aikacen da aka lissafa yana samun maki: 55% daga masu amfani da dawowa (mutanen da suka buɗe shi a wannan makon da makon da ya gabata), 35% daga masu amfani da mako-mako, da haɓaka 10% a cikin kwanaki 14 na farko. Kawai sanya hannu a asusun DeHub ƙidaya, don haka bots da shafin reloads ba su da wani abu.
dev.rewardsBody: Kowace wata {{pool}}tokens an raba tsakanin aikace-aikace ta maki ɗaya, an lasafta mako-mako. Don cancanta, aikace-aikacen yana buƙatar walat ɗin mai mallakar da aka tabbatar kuma akalla 3 masu amfani da dawowa. Ana biyan lada ta DeHub zuwa walat ɗin mai shi.
